title: Ice Grove, Luna Island (NYPL b11708202-G91F073 046F)
blurb: * Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Views are numbered: 830-834, 836, 838, 840, 841, 846, 848, 849, 853-855, 858, 859, 861, 864, 865, 866, 868-871, 874-876, 882, 884, 889, 894, 895, 924, 934-937, 939-941, 943, 944, 947-949, 951, 961, 966, 976. Winter views of Niagara: primarily views of icicles, ice columns, ice grottos and including views of the falls, Terrepin Tower, hotels and islands during the winter. Some views duplicated.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.21% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured deep (5.48% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at 33% size.
